name: Uta Shibata
source:
A certified Light Extrovert: Uta likes to be the center of attention, but only around a small group. He (knowingly) plays around way too much. Dripped in Sarcasm and cheesy puns, but chokes up when nervous: he will always be the shoulder to cry for whomever needs it.  And then make a joke to brighten the mood.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
